jobs.description:
We are Team possible – the people behind Proximus, Proximus NXT, Davinsi Labs, Codit, Proximus Ada, and more. Nice to see you here!
United by a shared purpose, we’re building a smarter, trustful and more connected world.
That means embracing technology and celebrating change.
We think possible and then make it possible. And of course, we love what we do.
Sounds like your kind of place?

Your job

Are you a passionate machine learning engineer with expertise in generative AI? Join our Machine Learning Enablers team at Proximus Ada, where you’ll play a key role in advancing and scaling generative AI capabilities across teams. You will leverage your expertise in architectures such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent-based systems to develop and maintain reusable components and templates that enable data scientists to deliver impactful solutions. 

In this role, you will collaborate closely with data scientists in delivery teams and engineers from our Cloud and DevSecOps teams to implement best practices and ensure technical excellence across multiple projects. Using frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph and our Azure-first stack, you will maintain and expand a shared repository of reusable generative AI assets that enable scalable, reliable solutions. 

Your innovative mindset will help identify emerging techniques and translate them into practical building blocks that deliver business value, keeping our teams aligned with the latest advances. Your work will support the day-to-day needs of our data scientists through the practical maintenance, hands-on support, and enhancement of shared assets, while also driving innovation in our generative AI initiatives. 

Responsibilities 

Develop and Maintain our Generative AI Repository 

• Manage and expand our shared repository of reusable Generative AI components and templates, ensuring it is robust, up-to-date, well-documented, and easy to adopt across use cases. 
• Support onboarding and adoption: help teams use the repository effectively, keep alignment with the main branch, and facilitate clean integration of shared changes. 
• Collaborate with data scientists to identify new components to build, provide technical support, and promote best practices in using the repository. 
• Drive key upgrades and migrations of core libraries and templates (e.g., LangChain/LangGraph) with minimal disruption to delivery teams. 
Enable Agent-Based and Generative AI Solutions 

• Guide delivery teams on architectures such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and agent-based systems, providing hands-on technical support and troubleshooting when needed. 
• Research and prototype emerging techniques, frameworks, and Azure services; translate validated approaches into reusable building blocks for delivery teams. 
Collaborate and Drive Technical Excellence 

• Define and promote software engineering best practices for Generative AI solutions (testing, code quality, style, automation) and enforce them through PR reviews and shared standards. 
• Collaborate with Cloud, DevSecOps, enterprise architecture, and vendors to ensure solutions and technologies align with our stack and constraints.
• Stay current with advances in Generative AI and communicate relevant learnings and recommendations to the organization. 

Your profile

Education 

• Master’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. 
• A Ph.D. is a plus, especially with research in Generative AI or agent-based systems. 
Professional Experience 

• Minimum of 2+ years of relevant experience in a business environment in AI/ML engineering or software engineering.
• Proven experience working with generative AI models and LLMs in real-world projects. 
• Demonstrated ability to build reusable components and templates, and transition proof-of-concepts into production-ready assets. 
• Experience collaborating with delivery teams and stakeholders, providing technical guidance and support. 
Technical Skills 

• Strong coding skills in Python, with solid software engineering best practices (testing, code quality, documentation, maintainable design). 
• Proficiency with version control (Git) and modern development workflows, including CI/CD pipelines. 
• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure and relevant Azure Data & AI services. 
• Experience with Generative AI frameworks such as LangChain; familiarity with LangGraph is a plus. 
• Experience implementing MLOps best practices (e.g., experiment tracking with MLflow). 
• Familiarity with monitoring and evaluation practices for Generative AI applications. 
Soft Skills 

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with attention to detail.
• Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts, provide actionable guidance, and produce high-quality documentation. 
• Collaboration and enablement mindset: comfortable supporting and mentoring others through code reviews and hands-on troubleshooting. 
• Ownership and autonomy: able to prioritize effectively and drive work to completion in a transversal context. 
• Curiosity and innovation mindset: proactive in exploring new techniques and translating them into practical improvements. 
Languages 

• Fluent in English and preferably also French and/or Dutch.

jobs.description:
Job description 
As a C driver at our company, you will start by transporting construction materials and machinery. This is done using different types of trucks, such as box trucks and crane trucks. You will not always be required to load and unload the cargo yourself, but occasionally your assistance may be needed. Do you have experience with a loading crane? That’s a plus! But don’t worry if you don’t, as you will receive internal training. If you already hold a C driving license, you also have the opportunity to progress to CE. This is your chance to further develop your career in the transport sector! What are you waiting for? Join our team and give your career a boost!

 Requirements 
  Start as a C Driver and Grow into CE Have you ever dreamed of hitting the road while taking your career to the next level? Then this is your chance! Start as a C driver and explore the opportunities to grow into a CE driver. Language skills In this role, it is important to have a good command of Dutch, French, and/or English. This not only helps in communication with customers but also broadens your opportunities in an increasingly international environment. Motivation to learn crane work We also offer you the opportunity to learn crane operation. Why let this chance pass you by? These additional skills increase your value on the job market and make you indispensable for future employers. It is not only an investment in your career, but also in your personal development. Why wait? Seize this opportunity to build a successful career as a driver. Now is the perfect time to take the step toward a challenging and rewarding future full of growth and new experiences. Take that first step today!

The Consulting Business Line at Sopra Steria is a team of over 160 consultants in Belgium with extensive expertise in Digital Transformation. Recognized as a preferred digital partner, we collaborate with leading Belgian organizations across the Public Sector, Financial Services, and Industry. Our consulting services span IT Advisory, Architecture, Organizational Transformation & Change, Operational Excellence, Sustainability & Ethics and Innovation as a Service.  

Your primary focus will be client engagements, which will constitute the majority of your time. These engagements may involve working as part of high-performing teams embedded within client organizations or contributing to Sopra Steria’s fixed-price Consulting projects within multidisciplinary teams. 

As a Consultant, you will contribute, as an integral member of the project team, to consulting assignments, you work closely with the client to listen and analyse their needs, you contribute to sales processes (spotting opportunities and drafting offers), and contributes to knowledge sharing within the organisation. On specific projects, your responsibilities may include business and functional analysis, project management, architectural design and Agile/Scrum facilitation. 

 

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application!

Education: you recently completed (or will soon complete) your Master education. Any Master where IT/Business/Economics/Management topics were positioned centrally are relevant. 

Experience: a first experience in Business/IT Consulting or any other relevant domain is a strong plus. No experience yet, but freshly graduated and highly motivated? We will definitely consider that as well! 

Business & IT: strong affinity and interest in digitalization, IT and technology, combined with a strong business acumen to build bridges between business and IT. 

Areas of Expertise: any skills obtained in one or more of the following domains is a plus: IT Advisory (Target Operating Models), Project Management, Business/Functional Analysis, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Architectural Design, ESG, or Product Management. 

Consulting Mindset: strong ability to build and maintain trustworthy client relationships, familiarity with business development approaches, and a strong connection to the Consulting "motherhouse." 

Languages: you are fluent in Dutch or French, have a good understanding of the other language, and are also fluent in English.

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Risk Specialist – HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
Your Job at a glance

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. Within our ‘Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)’ team, you will work closely with IT and Business Units to redefine Operational Risk Management, with a sharp focus on IT and Cyber Security.

This is not just a risk management role - it’s an opportunity to:

• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank’s defenses.
If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Your talents and skills

• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis’ businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt seamlessly between IT, business, and management discussions.
• Practical Framework Application: Proven ability to operationalize IT processes, Cyber Security Management Systems, and control frameworks—ensuring they deliver in practice.
• Certifications & Methodologies: CISSP, CISM, Operational Risk Management, or Agile experience are a plus, but not mandatory.

jobs.occupation: AP Manager | International Finance | Medical Sector
jobs.description:
Permanent | From €6,000 gross/month | Leuven

Thirty countries. Sixty legal entities. A BPO partner in India. Monthly closes under pressure and an ERP migration running straight through live operations. You've been there, and you know exactly how to bring structure, calm and quality to an environment that never stops moving.

 

We're looking for an AP Manager to lead the European AP hub of an international market leader in medical products, based in Leuven. This is a Global Business Services environment with teams spanning Belgium, the UK and India, an active finance transformation programme and products that make a genuine difference in healthcare every single day.

 

 

 

 

 

The Role

As AP Manager, you hold full ownership of the Accounts Payable function and serve as the key link between finance and international business stakeholders. From the European hub in Leuven, you oversee AP operations across Belgium, the United Kingdom and India, working closely with teams distributed around the world.

 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

• Full AP cycle for European countries: receipt, review, processing and approval of invoices in line with group policy
• Three-way matching, discrepancy follow-up and escalation where required
• Preparation and execution of payment runs across multiple methods (EFT, Wire, ACH, DD, SEPA B2B/B2C)
• Vendor reconciliations, AP subledger alignment with the GL and management of intercompany balances
• Monthly and year-end close activities: accruals, prepayments, open POs and AP adjustments
• Compliance oversight: VAT, Intrastat, SOX requirements, internal controls and segregation of duties
• Building and monitoring KPIs and AP reporting: ageing, vendor spend, payment forecasts and accrual summaries
• Supporting audit processes: providing documentation, explaining reconciliations and implementing recommendations
 

People Management & Leadership

• Managing, coaching and developing international AP teams and BPO partners
• Monitoring SLA quality and operational consistency across outsourced processes
• Providing technical guidance on the ERP system to BPO teams, acting as the go-to for complex processing and system queries
• Visible, engaged leadership: present for your people across time zones and national borders

Your Profile

You're a senior finance professional who knows complex AP environments inside out. You keep your team in sight and know how to introduce structure and composure into an organisation that's constantly evolving.

 

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a financial discipline
• A minimum of 10 years' relevant experience in AP and GL, ideally across multiple countries and legal entities
• Proven leadership experience, both direct and through BPO coordination and process ownership
• Hands-on knowledge of major ERP systems such as Oracle Cloud Financials or SAP S/4HANA
• Familiar with US GAAP and/or IFRS and financial close across multiple entities
• Strong knowledge of VAT in an international context, SOX and internal controls
• Demonstrable experience with finance transformation or ERP implementation projects is a significant advantage
• Analytical, solutions-focused and comfortable in a high-complexity, fast-changing environment
• Fluent in English (essential); French or Dutch is an advantage
• Willing to travel internationally: regular trips to the UK, occasional travel to Asia

About this vacancy
As a Business & Process Analyst, you play a pivotal role in bridging business needs, operational processes, and technology solutions. You work closely with stakeholders across the organization to analyze business requirements, optimize processes, and translate needs into clear, actionable deliverables.

This role combines traditional business analysis with process improvement responsibilities. We are looking for someone who is not only an excellent communicator but also highly analytical, comfortable working with complex data, and capable of approaching challenges with a strong quantitative and logical mindset.
Your responsibilities include:
• Gathering, analyzing, and documenting business requirements from various stakeholders.
• Translating business needs into clear functional specifications and Product Backlog Items (PBIs).
• Writing, maintaining, and refining PBIs to support development and delivery teams.
• Mapping, analyzing, and optimizing end-to-end business processes.
• Identifying inefficiencies, bottlenecks, risks, and opportunities for process improvement.
• Facilitating workshops, requirement-gathering sessions, and stakeholder interviews.
• Collaborating closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, developers, and business stakeholders.
• Supporting the implementation of new solutions and ensuring alignment with business objectives.
• Performing data analysis to support decision-making and validate process improvements.
• Defining and documenting business rules, process flows, and functional requirements.
• Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
• Supporting testing activities, acceptance criteria reviews, and solution validation
What we expect from you
• Minimum 5 years of experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, or in a combined business/process transformation role.
• Proven experience in both business analysis and process analysis within complex environments.
• Strong experience writing and managing Product Backlog Items (PBIs) and working within Agile delivery frameworks.
• Ability and willingness to actively contribute to backlog management and requirement definition activities.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a structured approach to decision-making.
• Excellent quantitative reasoning skills and the ability to work with data-driven insights.
• A strong affinity with mathematics, logic, process modeling, and analytical thinking.
• Ability to quickly understand complex business challenges and translate them into practical solutions.
• Experience with business process mapping methodologies and continuous improvement frameworks.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across both business and technical teams.
• Comfort working with data, KPIs, reporting, and performance measurements.
• Experience working alongside technical teams and understanding technical constraints and opportunities.
• Knowledge of Agile methodologies, Scrum, and modern delivery practices.
• Experience with BPMN is considerd a must. Language requirements
• Professional proficiency in French and English is mandatory.
• Strong written communication skills in both languages are required for documentation and stakeholder engagement.

Are you ready to help shape and secure the global network that keeps Lotus Bakeries connected across 4 continents?
 

As a Network & Security Engineer, you’ll play a key role in our international Infrastructure team. You will take ownership of the design, implementation, support and continuous improvement of our global network and security landscape, ensuring that our offices and production sites can rely on a connected, performant and secure environment.
 

Our team manages the IT infrastructure for more than 30 locations and 2000+ users worldwide. Together, we make sure our business can operate safely and efficiently by combining strong network foundations with the right security measures, enabling a resilient and future-proof digital workplace.
 

 
 

About the job
 
 

• You participate in international infrastructure projects and execute network and security-related activities within budget, scope and timing. You play an active role in continuously improving the reliability, performance and security of our global infrastructure. 

• Your activities can range from network changes, connectivity setups and application integrations to implementing and optimizing security controls across our IT environment. You help ensure that our network architecture and security posture evolve alongside the needs of our business and production environments. 

• You take ownership of operational support by monitoring the network and security environment, following up incidents with external partners, and leading 3th level troubleshooting when required. You coordinate connectivity and security-related changes with internal stakeholders and external suppliers in areas such as WAN, firewalls, SD-WAN, cloud services, identity management and certificates. 

• In this role, you combine a hands-on approach with a continuous improvement mindset. You identify risks, propose improvements and contribute to the development of a robust, secure and scalable infrastructure roadmap. 

To be successful in this role, we believe you bring:
 
 

• · 
 A relevant academic background and several years of experience in a similar role within network and/or security engineering. 

• · 
 Good knowledge of firewall technologies, network segmentation, SD-WAN concepts and general network security principles. 

• · 
 Experience with implementing and maintaining security controls in a modern enterprise environment. 

• · 
 A broad understanding of IT infrastructure with hands-on experience in areas such as: Microsoft Windows environments, Microsoft 365, Active Directory and certificates, servers, storage and virtualization technologies, IT infrastructure in production environments (OT experience is considered a plus), good knowledge of ITIL processes and the ability to apply them in daily operations, a broad interest in infrastructure and security topics, enabling you to evaluate challenges and define future-proof solutions. 

• · 
 Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with internal teams, external partners and suppliers. 

• · 
 A proactive, hands-on attitude combined with a flexible mindset and a strong drive for continuous improvement.

 Language skills that include Dutch and English. Knowledge of French is considered a plus.
